integrity: Exact moves, quantifiers and critical-family uniqueness are proved; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the complete critical configuration set at total 4m-1 for friendship graphs with m>=2 is asserted as new; scalar stacking/clearing thresholds and an example obstruction were established previously. Infinite proof is symbolic; finite tests are corroborative. Priority is provisional against inaccessible follow-up manuscripts.
title: Complete critical-obstruction classification for friendship-graph pebbling
